justification: Blog stated wrong granny flat CDC rules (one fixed setback, 1 parking space, two-storey 1.5 m) plus unsourced typical DCP ranges; now cites Housing SEPP 2021 Schedule 1.

functions.name: SEPPvsDCPTable
functions.input: static rows typed in this component
functions.output: two value columns, each SEPP value naming Schedule 1
functions.if_none: static content, nothing can be missing at runtime

break_it.scenario: a reader on a 1000 m2 lot uses 3 m rear
break_it.what_happens: they would plan with too small a rear setback
break_it.repro: read the table row Rear setback
break_it.how: row now says 450-900 m2 only and larger on bigger lots and taller buildings

break_it.scenario: reader adds a parking space they do not need
break_it.what_happens: old table said 1 additional space required
break_it.how: now quotes Schedule 1 s2(3): no additional space required

break_it.scenario: reader assumes DCP never touches a CDC
break_it.what_happens: they could miss the DCP stormwater requirement
break_it.how: box now names the stormwater exception (Schedule 1 s19)
